hook: Proving compilers correct, automatically, for languages never seen.

beats.say: MIT professor Adam Chlipala describes new research, to appear at POPL twenty twenty-seven, that uses e-graphs to verify compilers.
E-graphs efficiently explore many alternative ways to write algebraic expressions, which helps both program verification and optimization.
The tool takes a compiler definition for a new language, with no extra proof annotations, and proves it correct automatically.
